description: This file defines the ClientManifestProvider class responsible for creating and providing a manifest of locally available grain interface types in an Orleans-based application. It includes methods for generating the manifest based on grain interface properties and resolving interface types.

classes.name: ClientManifestProvider
classes.description: Creates and provides a manifest of local grain interface types for Orleans clients.

methods.name: ClientManifestProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with grain interface property providers, options, and a resolver, generating the client manifest.

methods.name: CreateInterfaceManifest
methods.description: Private static method that creates an immutable dictionary mapping interface types to their properties by processing interface options and property providers.
